description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (716.924) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (584.069) less the matching prior-year period (503.538).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 716.924，加本财年累计 584.069，减去上年同期累计 503.538。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Retail margin tightens and AWS capacity absorbs more ongoing expense.
rationale.zh: 零售利润率收紧，AWS 产能增加持续性费用。

rationale.en: AWS and ads take more of the sales mix as retail costs scale.
rationale.zh: AWS 与广告提高收入占比，零售成本随规模优化。

rationale.en: Stronger AWS utilization and advertising lift underlying earnings.
rationale.zh: AWS 利用率和广告增长提高基础盈利。
